versions.content: Large Data Path I-PDU Excluded Features If ComIPduLargeData is set to true then the following parameters and containers shall not be configured for the ComIPdu : • ComIPduCallout • ComIPduCancellationSupport • ComIPduTriggerTransmitCallout • ComIPduMainFunctionRef • ComIPduSignalGroupRef • ComMainFunctionRouteSignalsRef • ComMetaDataDefaultItem
